tutorial_2: This is the lab's **scanning electron microscope**.|| Its electron gun fires a focused beam at the sample.
tutorial_3: The beam kicks out characteristic X-rays || that let us tell the minerals apart.
tutorial_4: Move it with the << LEFT and RIGHT arrows <<, and press >> SPACE >> to fire the beam.
tutorial_5: Hit every mineral before it reaches the bottom, || or you'll lose a life!
prepare_2: New sample, faster beam — get ready!
